title: Website Developer
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2513), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: Walk us through a website you designed and built. How did you decide on the layout and the user's path through it?
questions.source: eMASCO 2513, task 1: Menganalisis, mereka bentuk dan membangunkan laman Internet dengan menggunakan hasil seni dan kreativiti…

questions.text: Tell us how you connected a web page to data or a back end, for example a form that saves to a database.
questions.source: eMASCO 2513, task 4: Mereka bentuk, membangunkan dan menyepadukan kod komputer dengan input khusus lain…

questions.text: Describe a time a website problem turned out to be about hosting, the network or the server rather than your code. How did you work it out?
questions.source: eMASCO 2513, task 3: Berhubung dengan pakar rangkaian berkenaan dengan isu yang berkaitan dengan web…
